# 1. Data Import 
```{r import, include=FALSE}
setwd("~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis/Backbone_Raw")

# Read each featureCounts tabular file individually
iPSC_K15_WT <- read.table("iPSC_K15.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
iPSC_K37_WT <- read.table("iPSC_K37.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
iPSC_K53_WT <- read.table("iPSC_K53.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
eMPC_K15_WT <- read.table("eMPC_K15.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
eMPC_K37_WT <- read.table("eMPC_K37.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
eMPC_K53_WT <- read.table("eMPC_K53.tabular", header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
EC_K15_WT   <- read.table("EC_K15.tabular",   header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
EC_K37_WT   <- read.table("EC_K37.tabular",   header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)
EC_K53_WT   <- read.table("EC_K53.tabular",   header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1)

# Merge all samples into a single count matrix
dif.read.counts <- cbind(
  iPSC_K15_WT, iPSC_K37_WT, iPSC_K53_WT,

  "EC_A",   "EC_B",   "EC_C"

```


# 2. Ensembl ID to HGNC Symbol Conversion
```{r counts, include=FALSE}

# Preserve original count matrix - work on a copy to avoid altering raw data
raw_reads <- dif.read.counts

# Store Ensembl IDs from row names
genes <- rownames(raw_reads)

# Retrieve HGNC symbols for all Ensembl IDs
# The mapping is saved to a file the first time, so later knits do not depend on Ensembl
map_file <- "~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis/ensembl_hgnc_map.rds"

if (file.exists(map_file)) {
  G_list <- readRDS(map_file)
} else {
  # Same BioMart query as getBM (ensembl_gene_id + hgnc_symbol, unique rows),
  # sent as GET because POST requests from biomaRt returned HTTP 405
  query_xml <- paste0(
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query>',
    '<Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="1" uniqueRows="1">',
    '<Dataset name="hsapiens_gene_ensembl" interface="default">',
    '<Attribute name="ensembl_gene_id"/><Attribute name="hgnc_symbol"/>',
    '</Dataset></Query>'
  )
  url <- paste0("https://www.ensembl.org/biomart/martservice?query=",
                utils::URLencode(query_xml, reserved = TRUE))
  res <- curl::curl_fetch_memory(url)
  full_map <- read.delim(text = rawToChar(res$content), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(full_map) <- c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol")
  full_map$hgnc_symbol[is.na(full_map$hgnc_symbol)] <- ""

  # Keep only the IDs present in this dataset (as getBM with a filter would return)
  G_list <- full_map[full_map$ensembl_gene_id %in% genes, ]
  saveRDS(G_list, map_file)
}

# Add Ensembl IDs as a column for merging
raw_reads$ensembl_gene_id <- rownames(raw_reads)

# Merge count matrix with HGNC symbols
eltable <- merge(raw_reads, G_list, by = "ensembl_gene_id", all = TRUE)

# Remove genes without a corresponding HGNC symbol
eltable <- subset(eltable, hgnc_symbol != "" & !is.na(hgnc_symbol))

# Remove Ensembl ID column
eltable$ensembl_gene_id <- NULL

# Collapse duplicate HGNC symbols by summing counts
read.counts <- eltable %>%
  group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

read.counts <- as.data.frame(read.counts)

# Set HGNC symbols as row names
row.names(read.counts) <- read.counts$hgnc_symbol
read.counts$hgnc_symbol <- NULL

# Update main working object with HGNC-annotated counts
dif.read.counts <- read.counts
```

# 3. Extra Quality Control

Let's check for sample complexity. It is possible that one or more samples have different complexity. In specific, I am going to check if enough reads have been obtained from every sample. If not, we should have a great bias to housekeeping genes. Another way to put it, is to say that even with all reads, we won't obtain a great deal of different genes.

```{r complexity, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}

# Create dataset with cumulative reads per sample
cumulative_counts <- c()

for (i in 1:ncol(dif.read.counts)) {
  temporary <- dif.read.counts[order(dif.read.counts[, i], decreasing = TRUE), ]
  database <- cumsum(temporary[, i])
  cumulative_counts <- cbind(cumulative_counts, database)
}

cumulative_counts <- as.data.frame(cumulative_counts)
colnames(cumulative_counts) <- paste0("Sample_", 1:ncol(cumulative_counts))

# Reshape to long format
cumulative_long <- cumulative_counts %>%
  mutate(genes = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Sample_"),
               names_to = "Sample",
               values_to = "Reads")

# Plot 1 - Cumulative reads per sample (log10)
p1 <- ggplot(cumulative_long, aes(x = genes, y = log10(Reads),
                                   group = Sample, color = Sample)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Number of Genes Covered") +
  ylab("Number of Reads (log10)") +
  xlim(0, 16000) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Sample", values = rep("red", ncol(cumulative_counts)))

print(p1)

# Get maximum cumulative value per sample (last gene)
max_per_sample <- cumulative_long %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  filter(genes == max(genes)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate percentage of total reads per gene per sample
cumulative_pct <- cumulative_long %>%
  left_join(max_per_sample, by = "Sample", suffix = c("", "_max")) %>%
  mutate(value = (Reads / Reads_max) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, genes, value)

# Plot 2 - Cumulative reads as percentage
p2 <- ggplot(cumulative_pct, aes(x = genes, y = value,
                                  group = Sample, color = Sample)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Number of Genes Covered") +
  ylab("Number of Reads (%)") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(cumulative_long$genes))) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Sample", values = rep("red", ncol(cumulative_counts)))

print(p2)

```

```{r filtration 2}
# Apply filter - keep genes with log10 total reads > 2.7 across all samples
filtered_counts <- subset(dif.read.counts, log_counts_all > 2.7)
```

# 3. Matrices

Desig of our matrices. 

```{r matrixes and normalization}

# Create DGEList object from filtered count table
dgelist <- DGEList(counts_filtered)

# Calculate normalisation factors (TMM method)
# Note: this step calculates the factors but does not normalise yet
dgelist <- calcNormFactors(dgelist)

# Define group labels for the design matrix
# Each cell type has 3 biological replicates
group_labels <- c(
  "iPSC", "iPSC", "iPSC",
  "eMPC", "eMPC", "eMPC",
  "EC",   "EC",   "EC"
)

# Build the design matrix
# ~0 means no intercept - each group gets its own coefficient
mm <- model.matrix(~0 + group_labels)

# Apply voom normalisation
# This converts counts to log2-CPM and estimates the
# mean-variance relationship needed for linear modelling
y <- voom(dgelist, mm, plot = FALSE)

saveRDS(y, "y_voom_backbone.rds")

# Extract normalised expression matrix
normalised_counts <- y$E

# Save normalised results to file
write.table(normalised_counts, 
            "~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis/normalised_counts.txt", 
            row.names = TRUE, 
            col.names = TRUE)
```
# 4. Normalization

Convert read counts to log2-CPM to visualise normalisation quality. Check if medians are at similar level and few outliers.

```{r normalization}

library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(ggpubr)

# Convert filtered counts to data.table for plotting
dfforboxy <- as.data.table(counts_filtered, keep.rownames = FALSE)
orderforplots <- sample_labels

# Create a sample type/color mapping
colouring <- data.table(Sample = colnames(dfforboxy), Types = orderforplots)

# Melt the data.table
dfforboxy_melt <- melt(dfforboxy, variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Expression")
dfforboxy_melt <- merge(dfforboxy_melt, colouring, by = "Sample")

# Define a named color vector to ensure correct mapping
color_map <- c(
  "iPSC_A" = "lightblue",
  "iPSC_B" = "lightblue",
  "iPSC_C" = "lightblue",
  "eMPC_A" = "lightsalmon",
  "eMPC_B" = "lightsalmon",
  "eMPC_C" = "lightsalmon",
  "EC_A"   = "lightgreen",
  "EC_B"   = "lightgreen",
  "EC_C"   = "lightgreen"
)

# Pre-normalisation boxplot
prenorm <- ggplot(dfforboxy_melt, aes(x = Sample, y = log2(Expression + 1), fill = Types)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Normalised Counts (log2)") +
  xlab("Samples") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Cell Type", values = color_map) +

    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),

# Post-normalisation boxplot

dfforboxy_post_melt <- melt(dfforboxy_post, variable.name = "Sample", value.name = "Expression")
dfforboxy_post_melt <- merge(dfforboxy_post_melt, colouring, by = "Sample")

postnorm <- ggplot(dfforboxy_post_melt, aes(x = Sample, y = Expression, fill = Types)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +

  xlab("Samples") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Cell Type", values = color_map) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ggtitle("After Voom Normalisation")

# Arrange side by side
ggarrange(prenorm, postnorm, nrow = 1)

```
# 5. PCA

PCA clusters replicates and reveals the differentiation trajectory.

```{r PCA}

# Prepare data matrix for PCA
dfforpca <- y$E
dfforpca <- rbind(dfforpca, sample_labels)
dfforpca <- t(dfforpca)

numcol <- c(1:(ncol(dfforpca)-1))

# Convert to data frame and numeric columns
dfforpca <- as.data.frame(dfforpca)
dfforpca[, numcol] <- apply(dfforpca[, numcol], 2,
                             function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Specify the factor levels in trajectory order
dfforpca$sample_labels <- factor(dfforpca$sample_labels, levels = unique(sample_labels))

# Run PCA
pca_res <- prcomp(dfforpca[, numcol], scale = FALSE)

# Create a new column with just the cell type (strip _A, _B, _C)
dfforpca$timepoint <- sub("_(A|B|C)$", "", dfforpca$sample_labels)

# PCA plot
p <- autoplot(
  pca_res,
  data = dfforpca,
  x = 1,
  y = 2,
  colour = "timepoint",
  size = 8,
  alpha = 0.7
)

# Apply manual colors (one per cell type)
p <- p + theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Cell Type",
    values = c(
      "iPSC" = "lightblue",
      "eMPC" = "lightsalmon",
      "EC"   = "lightgreen"
    )
  ) +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

p

# Top contributing genes per PC
contribs1 <- pca_res$rotation[, 1]
contribs2 <- pca_res$rotation[, 2]
contribs3 <- pca_res$rotation[, 3]

# Biggest contributors to PC1 
(pos1genes <- sort(contribs1, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg1genes <- sort(contribs1, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

# Biggest contributors to PC2 
(pos2genes <- sort(contribs2, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg2genes <- sort(contribs2, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

# Biggest contributors to PC3
(pos3genes <- sort(contribs3, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg3genes <- sort(contribs3, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

# Export to Excel

  Rank = 1:100,
```

# 6. Linear Models

Fit linear models to identify differentially expressed genes between each step of the differentiation trajectory.

```{r Linear Models}

# Redefine group labels without replicate letters for model fitting
group_labels <- c(
  "iPSC", "iPSC", "iPSC",
  "eMPC", "eMPC", "eMPC",
  "EC",   "EC",   "EC"
)

# Build design matrix
mm <- model.matrix(~0 + group_labels)

# Apply voom normalization with group-level design matrix
y <- voom(dgelist, mm, plot = FALSE)

# Fit linear model
fitted <- lmFit(y, mm)
head(coef(fitted))

# Define step-to-step contrasts:

# iPSC -> eMPC (Day 0 to Day 3)
contr_iPSC_eMPC <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelseMPC - group_labelsiPSC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted)))

# eMPC -> EC (Day 3 to Day 11)
contr_eMPC_EC <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelsEC - group_labelseMPC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted)))

# iPSC -> EC (Day 0 to Day 11)
contr_iPSC_EC <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelsEC - group_labelsiPSC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted)))

# Estimate contrasts for each gene
tmp_iPSC_eMPC <- contrasts.fit(fitted, contr_iPSC_eMPC)
tmp_eMPC_EC   <- contrasts.fit(fitted, contr_eMPC_EC)
tmp_iPSC_EC   <- contrasts.fit(fitted, contr_iPSC_EC)

# Apply empirical Bayes smoothing of standard errors (shrinks extreme standard errors):

# iPSC vs eMPC (Day 0 -> Day 3)
tmp_iPSC_eMPC <- eBayes(tmp_iPSC_eMPC)
top.table_iPSC_eMPC <- topTable(tmp_iPSC_eMPC, sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_iPSC_eMPC <- top.table_iPSC_eMPC
DEGenes_iPSC_eMPC$GeneID <- row.names(DEGenes_iPSC_eMPC)

# eMPC vs EC (Day 3 -> Day 11)
tmp_eMPC_EC <- eBayes(tmp_eMPC_EC)
top.table_eMPC_EC <- topTable(tmp_eMPC_EC, sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_eMPC_EC <- top.table_eMPC_EC
DEGenes_eMPC_EC$GeneID <- row.names(DEGenes_eMPC_EC)

# iPSC vs EC (Day 0 -> Day 11)
tmp_iPSC_EC <- eBayes(tmp_iPSC_EC)
top.table_iPSC_EC <- topTable(tmp_iPSC_EC, sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_iPSC_EC <- top.table_iPSC_EC
DEGenes_iPSC_EC$GeneID <- row.names(DEGenes_iPSC_EC)
```
# 7. Gene Panel

This section visualises the expression of a panel of canonical markers across the three differentiation stages (iPSC, eMPC, EC), using voom-normalised counts from the filtered dataset.

## 7.1. Canonical Marker Gene Check

Prior to panel construction, we verified which canonical markers from the theoretical database were detectable in the dataset, both before and after low-expression filtering.

```{r gene_validation}

# Define canonical marker genes from the theoretical database
markers_iPSC <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")

markers_eMPC <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", 
                  "CD34", "KDR", "BMP4", "INHBA", "FGF2", "VEGFA")

markers_EC <- c("SOX17", "ERG", "NR2F2", "PECAM1", 
                "CDH5", "EFNB2", "EPHB4", "CXCR4", "VWF", "NOS3", "ASS1")

all_markers <- unique(c(markers_iPSC, markers_eMPC, markers_EC))

# Check presence in pre-filtration count matrix
present_prefilt <- all_markers[all_markers %in% rownames(dif.read.counts)]
absent_prefilt  <- all_markers[!all_markers %in% rownames(dif.read.counts)]

cat("=== PRE-FILTRATION ===\n")
cat("Present:", paste(present_prefilt, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Absent: ", paste(absent_prefilt,  collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check presence in post-filtration count matrix
present_postfilt <- all_markers[all_markers %in% rownames(counts_filtered)]
absent_postfilt  <- all_markers[!all_markers %in% rownames(counts_filtered)]

cat("\n=== POST-FILTRATION ===\n")
cat("Present:", paste(present_postfilt, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Absent: ", paste(absent_postfilt,  collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
# 8. Gene Panel Heatmap

Canonical markers across iPSC-to-EC differentiation using voom-normalised counts (y$E) from backbone pipeline.

```{r gene_panel, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# Define Gene Panel
#pluripotency         <- c("SOX2", "MYC")
#mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "KDR", "ETV2")
#endothelial_identity <- c("CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

# Define Gene Panel (full canonical panel)
pluripotency         <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
endothelial_identity <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

genes_use_backbone <- c(pluripotency, mesoderm_induction, endothelial_identity)

# Keep only genes present after filtration/normalisation
genes_use_backbone <- genes_use_backbone[genes_use_backbone %in% rownames(y$E)]

# Create stage mapping
stage_map_backbone <- c(
  setNames(rep("Pluripotency", length(pluripotency)), pluripotency),
  setNames(rep("Mesoderm induction", length(mesoderm_induction)), mesoderm_induction),
  setNames(rep("Endothelial identity", length(endothelial_identity)), endothelial_identity)
)

row_stage_backbone <- factor(
  stage_map_backbone[genes_use_backbone],
  levels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity")
)

# Subset and row-scale expression matrix
mat <- y$E[genes_use_backbone, , drop = FALSE]
mat_scaled_backbone <- t(scale(t(mat)))

# Replace possible NA values caused by zero-variance genes
mat_scaled_backbone[is.na(mat_scaled_backbone)] <- 0

# Clean column names
colnames(mat_scaled_backbone) <- c(
  "iPSC_1", "iPSC_2", "iPSC_3",
  "eMPC_1", "eMPC_2", "eMPC_3",
  "EC_1",   "EC_2",   "EC_3"
)

# Column groups
col_group_backbone <- factor(
  c(rep("iPSC", 3), rep("eMPC", 3), rep("EC", 3)),
  levels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC")
)

# Heatmap colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Top annotation: group names above each column block
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = anno_block(
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "black")
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  height = unit(7, "mm")
)

# Left annotation: stage names next to each row block
left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Stage = anno_block(
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", col = "black"),
    labels_rot = 0
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  width = unit(37, "mm")
)

# Draw heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled_backbone,
  name = "Z-score\nexpression",
  col = col_fun,
  
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  row_split = row_stage_backbone,
  column_split = col_group_backbone,
  
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,
  
  column_title = NULL,
  row_title = NULL,
  
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  
  row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
  
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.6),
  border = TRUE,
  
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score\nexpression",
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
  )
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC, eMPC and EC stages",
  column_title_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 2), "mm")
)

```
# 8. Export Results 
```{r export}
library(writexl)

# Define full canonical panel for export
canonical_genes <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC",
                     "TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34",
                     "PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")


# Create output directory
dir.create("results/Backbone", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Gene availability table
gene_availability <- data.frame(
  gene          = canonical_genes,
  in_dataset    = canonical_genes %in% rownames(dif.read.counts),
  after_filter  = canonical_genes %in% rownames(y$E),
  status        = ifelse(
    !canonical_genes %in% rownames(dif.read.counts), "Absent from dataset",
    ifelse(!canonical_genes %in% rownames(y$E), "Removed by filtration", "Used")
  )
)

write.csv(gene_availability,
          "results/Backbone/gene_availability.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# 2. PCA plot
pdf("results/Backbone/pca_plot.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()

# 3. Heatmap
pdf("results/Backbone/heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 6.5)
draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC, eMPC and EC stages - Backbone",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
dev.off()

write.csv(mat_scaled_backbone, "results/Backbone/mat_z.csv")

# Export objects required by downstream DEG analysis
saveRDS(DEGenes_iPSC_eMPC, 
        "DEGenes_iPSC_eMPC_backbone.rds")
saveRDS(DEGenes_eMPC_EC,   
        "DEGenes_eMPC_EC_backbone.rds")
saveRDS(DEGenes_iPSC_EC,   
        "DEGenes_iPSC_EC_backbone.rds")
```
